title: 2012 Topps Prime Retail #148 Bernard Pierce Baltimore Ravens Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2012 Topps Prime sports trading card features Bernard Pierce, a rookie player for the Baltimore Ravens in the National Football League (NFL). The card is a part of the retail parallel/variety set and has the card number 148. It is a great addition for any football fan or sports trading card collector, especially those who are fans of the Baltimore Ravens. The card is in excellent shape and is a part of the 2012 season.
